candidate: H50 dual-bitplane per-neuron chord atlas all-layer functional audit

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H50 preserves one tensor-core GEMM pair and passes token-time systems gates. Test whether two charged shared ambient sign planes plus independent row-local layer coordinates resolve H48's global low-rank alignment bottleneck.

scientific_question: Can two shared one-bit endpoint planes with independent per-layer/per-neuron two-coordinate chords reproduce all twelve terminal dense MLP functions and exact input JVPs under one percent checkpoint bytes?

frozen_representation.global_codes: binary {-1,+1} packed one bit per endpoint scalar
frozen_representation.global_scale_policy: one FP16 mean-absolute scale for every role, plane and row
frozen_representation.layer_private_coordinates: one independent FP16 coefficient for every layer, endpoint role, plane and row
frozen_representation.atom_pairing: teacher detector/write endpoints are selected together and assigned to the same plane row; learned detector and write coefficients may differ because the function requires independent read/write amplitudes

teacher_derived_initialization.plane_zero_assignment: top 192 atoms from layer l occupy row group l
teacher_derived_initialization.plane_one_assignment: ranked atoms 192:384 from layer (l+1) mod 12 occupy row group l
teacher_derived_initialization.cross_layer_pairing: row group l therefore pairs plane-zero layer l with plane-one layer (l+1) mod 12
teacher_derived_initialization.binary_quantizer: sign with zeros mapped to +1; one FP16 mean-absolute scale per endpoint vector
teacher_derived_initialization.coordinate_initialization: one at the source layer/plane/row and zero elsewhere, independently for detector and write roles

fit.objective: mean relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact input-JVP MSE
fit.optimizer: AdamW only on layer-private chord coordinates
fit.layer_schedule: deterministic round-robin over all twelve layers

controls.plane_zero_only: zero all plane-one coordinates while retaining the identical allocated artifact shape
controls.random_shared_planes: replace both frozen sign planes by deterministic equal-shape random signs while retaining scales and fitted coordinates
controls.row_shared_scalar_coordinates: replace every row coefficient by its layer/role/plane mean
controls.shuffled_layer_coordinates: cyclically assign each layer the next layer's fitted coordinates
controls.dense_teacher: exact teacher output and input-JVP identity

runtime_gates.watchdog_policy: terminal/error callbacks plus one resettable 90-minute heartbeat for a run expected below two hours

promotion: Only every-layer representation pass plus exact compact identity and the sealed systems pass may authorize one exact 124M causal training preflight. A pass still does not authorize scale-up.
failure: Close exact H50 row-separable dual-bitplane width-2304 topology without plane-count, width, acquisition, optimizer, CE, or scale sweep.
forbidden: stored PCA or empirical trajectory basis
persistent FP16 or FP32 dense endpoint master
changing plane count, width, quantizer, assignment, optimizer or gates after seeing results
CE or scale-up before every representation and systems gate passes
calling cached materialized endpoints compact checkpoint state
